description: This file defines a React component TagTable which renders a table of tags with functionalities for sorting, editing, deleting, and selecting tags. It uses external libraries like @tanstack/react-table for table logic, @heroicons/react/outline for icons, @tremor/react for UI components, and antd for tooltips.
